description: This file defines extension methods for the IGrainContext interface in Orleans, specifically providing a method to retrieve grain extensions of a specified type.

classes.name: GrainContextComponentExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IGrainContext related to grain extensions.

methods.name: GetGrainExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a grain extension of the specified type from the grain context, throwing an exception if the extension binder is not available.
